reason: Deleting a draft is permanent, not a move to Trash. Check the founder actually wants that draft gone before it disappears.
Deleting a label removes it from every message that carries it. Check the founder named this label before it goes.
Trashing a prospect's message or the founder's own sent mail could hide it from the next reply search. Check first.
Same as trash_message, for a whole thread.
Marking a message as spam can hide a genuine reply from ever being found by search. Check first.
Same as mark_message_spam, for a whole thread.
Renaming or recoloring a label changes it everywhere it is used in the founder's mailbox. Check first.
A new label changes the founder's own organizing system. Check they actually want one before adding it.
